text: INSIGHT 03 / 08 DEVELOPMENT; THE ART OF SAYING NO; THE FRIEND ON THE PHONE
sees: A worried young woman with a ponytail in a gray hoodie stands at left; at right a large green smartphone with an orange speech bubble containing three dots. Gray background with light rays.
message: A friend is contacting her on the phone, and she is uneasy about it.
wouldConfuse: none

text: INSIGHT 03 / 08 DEVELOPMENT; THE ART OF SAYING NO; A LINGUISTIC WORKAROUND
sees: A smiling woman in a gray hoodie points toward a large green-and-orange key at right. Faint window, lamp and couch in the background.
message: There is a clever verbal trick, a key, that unlocks the situation.
wouldConfuse: The key could suggest access or secrets rather than a language trick.

text: INSIGHT 08 / 08 CLOSE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; SERVANT TO OTHER PRIORITIES
sees: A sad woman in a gray hoodie stands at left next to a chain of five links, the middle one orange and the others green. Warm beige background with rays.
message: Without saying no, you end up chained and serving other people's priorities.
wouldConfuse: none

text: INSIGHT 02 / 08 SETUP; THE ART OF SAYING NO; HATED BEING ASKED
sees: A worried woman in a gray hoodie, cropped at the shoulders, in a pale office with windows and a desk. Large text on the right.
message: She hated being asked for things.
wouldConfuse: none

text: INSIGHT 06 / 08 CONSEQUENCE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; ALREADY DROWNING IN TASKS
sees: A woman with a wobbly worried mouth and a gray hoodie, cropped, on a warm yellow background with rays. Large text at right.
message: She is already overwhelmed by too many tasks.
wouldConfuse: No tasks or workload are drawn, only the text and her face.

text: INSIGHT 04 / 08 TURN; THE ART OF SAYING NO; WE ARE PROBLEM SOLVERS
sees: A smiling woman in a gray hoodie at left below an orange banner with the text. A large glowing lightbulb with orange rays at right.
message: We like to think of ourselves as problem solvers with good ideas.
wouldConfuse: none

text: INSIGHT 05 / 08 CONSEQUENCE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; PROFESSIONAL SUICIDE (struck through with orange lines)
sees: A large close-up of a worried woman's face at right. The struck-through words at left on a warm cream background.
message: The fear that saying no is career suicide is being rejected.
wouldConfuse: Strikethrough could read as the phrase being cancelled or as a warning; the word suicide is alarming.

text: INSIGHT 05 / 08 TURN; THE ART OF SAYING NO; A MASSIVE SIDE PROJECT
sees: A man in a navy suit with a smirk points at a calm woman in a gray hoodie. An orange banner with text above them in an office.
message: The boss is handing her a huge extra project.
wouldConfuse: none

text: INSIGHT 08 / 08 CLOSE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; RESPECTING YOU MORE
sees: A large close-up of a worried woman's face at right with a faint frame on the wall. Text at left on a warm beige background.
message: Others will end up respecting you more.
wouldConfuse: Her worried face contradicts the positive message.

text: INSIGHT 04 / 08 TURN; THE ART OF SAYING NO; PAINTED YOURSELF INTO A CORNER
sees: A worried woman in a gray hoodie at left; a chain of five links, one orange, at right. Orange banner with text at top left.
message: You have trapped yourself with your own commitments.
wouldConfuse: A chain implies being bound rather than literally a corner.

text: INSIGHT 01 / 08 SETUP; THE ART OF SAYING NO; AN UNAUTHORIZED WITHDRAWAL
sees: A woman in a gray hoodie with a wobbly open mouth and tongue showing, startled. Pale office background. Large text at right.
message: Someone's request is felt as an unauthorized withdrawal from her resources.
wouldConfuse: Nothing financial is shown; the face looks nauseated or silly.

text: INSIGHT 08 / 08 CLOSE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; LOSE YOURSELF SLOWLY
sees: A large sad face of a woman at right with a downturned mouth. Warm beige rays and a faint frame behind. Text at left.
message: Never saying no makes you lose yourself little by little.
wouldConfuse: none

text: INSIGHT 02 / 08 DEVELOPMENT; THE ART OF SAYING NO; HEAD OVER THE CUBICLE WALL
sees: A worried woman in a gray hoodie in an office with windows and a desk; a small black outline of a device at bottom edge. Text at right.
message: Someone pops their head over the cubicle wall to ask her for something.
wouldConfuse: No cubicle wall or second person is shown.

text: INSIGHT 08 / 08 CLOSE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; ONE HONEST CRITICISM
sees: A man with glasses in a navy suit, neutral face, standing centered below the text. Cream background with circles.
message: A single honest criticism from a person such as a boss.
wouldConfuse: His neutral face and no action do not show criticism.

text: INSIGHT 04 / 08 TURN; THE ART OF SAYING NO; STOPS THE NEGOTIATION DEAD
sees: A smiling woman in a gray hoodie pointing to the right toward large text, in a gray office.
message: Her answer ends the negotiation immediately.
wouldConfuse: Smile suggests positive; no negotiation counterpart is shown.

text: INSIGHT 06 / 08 CONSEQUENCE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; STOP HER EMOTIONAL PAIN
sees: A woman in a gray hoodie on an orange kitchen background with a counter and fridge. The word PAIN covers her face. She points sideways.
message: The aim is to stop her emotional pain.
wouldConfuse: The text covers her face so her expression is unreadable.

text: INSIGHT 06 / 08 CONSEQUENCE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; NO OBLIGATION TO OPEN THE VAULT
sees: A worried woman in a gray hoodie holding up an orange wallet with a green card. Warm rays background. Text at right.
message: She has no obligation to hand over her money.
wouldConfuse: Vault is a metaphor, only a wallet is shown.

text: INSIGHT 07 / 08 CLOSE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; WORK THAT SOMEONE ELSE DIDN'T WANT
sees: A man in a navy suit holds out a paper note to a woman in a gray hoodie; both have neutral faces. Office background.
message: A coworker is passing her work he did not want to do.
wouldConfuse: none

text: INSIGHT 07 / 08 CONSEQUENCE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; SKIP THE FATIGUE ENTIRELY
sees: A woman in a gray hoodie points to a big orange-and-green shield with a white star at right. Cream background.
message: Protecting yourself with a firm no lets you avoid the fatigue.
wouldConfuse: none

text: INSIGHT 07 / 08 CONSEQUENCE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; SLEEPING SIX HOURS A NIGHT
sees: A worried woman in a gray hoodie holding a small phone at left; a large green phone with an orange chat bubble at right. Orange banner with text.
message: Constant messages cut her sleep to six hours a night.
wouldConfuse: No bed or sleep imagery is shown.

text: INSIGHT 07 / 08 CLOSE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; COLONIZED BY OTHER PEOPLE'S PRIORITIES
sees: A sad woman in a gray hoodie at left; at right a green marionette figure with an orange head hangs from a control bar by dashed strings.
message: Her life is controlled like a puppet by other people's priorities.
wouldConfuse: none

text: INSIGHT 01 / 08 SETUP; THE ART OF SAYING NO; NOT GENEROSITY
sees: A worried woman in a gray hoodie holding up a smartphone. Pale rays background. Text at right.
message: Her giving in is not generosity.
wouldConfuse: Phone does not relate to generosity.

text: INSIGHT 02 / 08 SETUP; THE ART OF SAYING NO; HOPING TO SURVIVE THE WEEK
sees: A tilted worried woman in a gray hoodie at left; a large hourglass with orange sand at right.
message: She is just hoping to survive the week as time runs out.
wouldConfuse: none

text: INSIGHT 03 / 08 DEVELOPMENT; THE ART OF SAYING NO; ROB THEM OF AGENCY
sees: A worried woman in a gray hoodie in a gray office. Large text at right.
message: Doing it all for others robs them of agency.
wouldConfuse: Image shows only her worry, not 'them'.

text: INSIGHT 01 / 08 SETUP; THE ART OF SAYING NO; A CONSTANT LOW-LEVEL HUM
sees: A grinning man with brown hair and small horns in a red shirt at left; a big green phone with an orange chat bubble at right.
message: Constant requests create a persistent hum of stress.
wouldConfuse: The horned figure looks like a devil, which could suggest a tempter.

text: INSIGHT 04 / 08 TURN; THE ART OF SAYING NO; WHERE PEOPLE COMPLETELY MESS UP
sees: A worried woman in a gray hoodie gesturing to the right in a gray office. Text at right.
message: This is where people completely mess up.
wouldConfuse: Nothing shows what the mistake is.

text: INSIGHT 02 / 08 DEVELOPMENT; THE ART OF SAYING NO; 4:55 P.M. ON A FRIDAY
sees: A worried woman in a gray hoodie at left; a huge clock face at right with orange and green hands.
message: It is almost the end of the day on a Friday.
wouldConfuse: Hands do not show 4:55.

text: INSIGHT 05 / 08 TURN; THE ART OF SAYING NO; A DECLARATION OF AGENCY
sees: A smiling woman with open mouth in a gray hoodie speaks at left; an orange banner with text at right. Cream background.
message: Saying no is a declaration of agency.
wouldConfuse: none

text: INSIGHT 01 / 08 SETUP; THE ART OF SAYING NO; A PERSONALITY TRAIT (all struck through with orange lines)
sees: On an orange background, struck-through large text, with a woman in a gray hoodie partly covered by the text, pointing sideways.
message: The problem is not a personality trait.
wouldConfuse: Text covers her face and the strikethrough could be misread.

text: INSIGHT 03 / 08 DEVELOPMENT; THE ART OF SAYING NO; RESPECT FOR THEIR TIME
sees: An angry man in a navy suit and a neutral woman in a gray hoodie facing forward, side by side in an office.
message: Show respect for the other person's time.
wouldConfuse: His anger conflicts with respect.
